title: [LOGGED OUT] Store tab bar arrows show the hidden categories

steps.text: Open https://site.ludus-game.com/store in the browser and wait until the page has finished loading.
If a "How we use cookies" banner is shown, click "Dismiss".
steps.saw: Banner shown; clicked Dismiss. Screenshot was taken while the banner was still closing (Dismiss button showed a spinner); banner was gone in the next screenshot
Scrolled down 1150px; Store heading and tab bar visible

steps.text: Is a right arrow shown at the right end of the tab bar?
steps.saw: Right arrow (>) at right end of tab bar; Gold partly cut off ('G')

steps.text: Click the right arrow at the right end of the tab bar.
steps.saw: Clicked the right arrow once (More categories); tab bar slid left, Emeralds still partly cut off in the screenshot (animation)

steps.text: Click the right arrow again, if it is still shown.
steps.saw: Right arrow was still shown in the page after the first click; clicked it again; tab bar now ends with Emeralds and the right arrow is gone

steps.text: Are "Gold" and "Emeralds" now fully visible at the right end of the tab bar?
steps.saw: Gold and Emeralds fully visible at the right end

steps.text: Is a left arrow now shown at the left end of the tab bar?
steps.saw: Left arrow (<) shown at left end; first tab cut off as 'attle Passes'

steps.text: Click the left arrow at the left end of the tab bar.
steps.saw: Clicked the left arrow (Previous categories) once; tab bar slid back

steps.text: Is "Free wares" fully visible again at the left end of the tab bar?
steps.saw: Free wares (yellow) fully visible at left end; right arrow shown again, no left arrow
